name: Streax Professional Hold and Play Funky Hair Colour Glorious Green (100gm)
description:
Streax Professional Hold and Play Funky Hair Colour – Glorious Green (100gm)
Country of Origin: Bangladesh

Turn heads with bold, vibrant hair using Streax Professional Hold and Play Funky Hair Colour. This semi-permanent colour delivers instant results and allows you to experiment with fun, unique shades without the hassle of a developer.

Key Features & Benefits:

Instant Vibrant Colour: Achieve a striking, semi-permanent green instantly.

Customizable Shades: Mix with other Funky Colours to create your own unique look.

Easy Application: Can be used directly, no developer needed.

Gentle on Hair: Free from ammonia and peroxide.

Fun & Trendy: Part of the Hold & Play Funky Colour range, perfect for adventurous and stylish hair transformations.

Available Shades in the Range: Crazy Violet, Wonder Blue, Glorious Green

Ideal for anyone who loves to switch up their hair colour frequently and express their style boldly.
